distance3_injection: In a bipartite girth>=8 graph, selected 3-edge paths inject into opposite-part nonedges, so P3 <= |L||R|-m.
leaf_defect: A leaf reaches at most four opposite vertices by a selected 3-edge path and therefore forces at least n_other-5 unreached nonedges; leaf endpoint pairs on one side are disjoint.
conclusion: The raw N1=51 layer is impossible and every bipartition degree profile at N1=49,50 violates the distance-3 injection or leaf-defect bound. Thus N1<=48; the exact cubic lower bound is then 651. Every q5 word of weight <625 has minimum chamber leader at least 29.
boundary: This closes leader 28 only. The q5/all-q minimum-distance theorem and the weight-625 equality shell remain open for leaders >=29.
